if문
while문
when 문기문 (switch 문이랑 비슷하다.)
for문 – 자바나 다른언어랑 다소차이가 있다.

fun main(){
    var data = 10

    //익스프레션에서는 else문 생략불가
    val result = if(data>0){
        println("data > 0")
        10
    }else{
        println("data <= 0")
        0
    }

    println(result)

    var data2: Any = "ackdark23"
    val result3 = when(data2){
        is String -> println("String....")
        20, 30 -> println("20,30")
        in 1..10 -> println("1..10")
        else -> println("else......")
    }

    println(result3)

    var data3 = arrayOf(10,20,30)
    
    //해당 인덱스를 참조하는 방법
    for(i in data3.indices){
        println(data3[i])
    }
    
    //값까지 같이 얻고싶다.
    for((index,value) in data3.withIndex()){
        println(value)
    }    
}

package com.example.ssamsstudypra.kotlinpra

open class Super{
    var publicData = 10
    protected var protectedData = 10
    private var privateData = 10

    open var someData = 10
    open fun someFun(){}

}
class Sub: Super() {
    override var someData = 10
    override fun someFun() {
        publicData ++
        protectedData ++
//      privateData ++ //error
    }
}

fun main(){
    val obj = Sub()
    obj.publicData ++
    //obj.proctedData ++ // error
    //obj.privateData ++ // error

}

fun main(){

package com.example.chapter6

import android.graphics.Typeface
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
import android.widget.ImageView
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat

class test1 : AppCompatActivity() {
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_test1)

        val name = TextView(this).apply {
            typeface = Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
            text="Lake Lovies"
        }

        val image = ImageView(this).also {
            it.setImageDrawable(ContextCompat.getDrawable(this,R.drawable.lake_1))
        }

        val address = TextView(this).apply {
            typeface = Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
            text = "lake Louse, AB, 캐나다다"
        }

        val layout = LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            addView(name, WRAP_CONTENT, WRAP_CONTENT)
            addView(image, WRAP_CONTENT, WRAP_CONTENT)
            addView(address, WRAP_CONTENT, WRAP_CONTENT)
        }

        setContentView(layout)

    }
}

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import android.os.Bundle
import android.util.Log
import android.view.KeyEvent
import android.view.MotionEvent
import com.example.chapter8.test.databinding.ActivityMainBinding
class EventPra : AppCompatActivity() {
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        val binding = ActivityMainBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)
    }
    override fun onTouchEvent(event: MotionEvent?): Boolean {
        when(event?.action){
            MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                Log.d("kkang", "touch down : ${event.x}, rawX: ${event.rawX}" )
            }
            MotionEvent.ACTION_UP ->{
                Log.d("kkang", "touch up : ${event.y} rawY: ${event.rawY}")
            }
        }
        return super.onTouchEvent(event)
    }
    override fun onKeyDown(keyCode: Int, event: KeyEvent?): Boolean {
        when(keyCode){
            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BACK -> Log.d("kkang", "back button click...")
            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_VOLUME_UP -> Log.d("kkang", "volumn_up button click...")
            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_VOLUME_DOWN -> Log.d( "kkang",  "volumn_down click...")
        }
        return super.onKeyDown(keyCode, event)
    }
}

package com.example.chapter8_event
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.SystemClock
import android.view.KeyEvent
import android.widget.Toast
import com.example.chapter8_event.databinding.ActivityMainBinding
class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    var initTime = 0L
    var pauseTime = 0L
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        val binding = ActivityMainBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)
        binding.startButton.setOnClickListener {
            binding.chronometer.base = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()+pauseTime
            binding.chronometer.start()
            binding.stopButton.isEnabled = true
            binding.resetButton.isEnabled = true
            binding.startButton.isEnabled = false
        }
        binding.stopButton.setOnClickListener {
            pauseTime = binding.chronometer.base - SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
            binding.chronometer.stop()
            binding.stopButton.isEnabled = false
            binding.resetButton.isEnabled = true
            binding.startButton.isEnabled = true
        }
        binding.resetButton.setOnClickListener {
            pauseTime = 0L
            binding.chronometer.base = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
            binding.chronometer.stop()
            binding.stopButton.isEnabled = false
            binding.resetButton.isEnabled = false
            binding.startButton.isEnabled = true
        }
    }
    override fun onKeyDown(keyCode: Int, event: KeyEvent?): Boolean {
        if(keyCode === KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BACK){
            if(System.currentTimeMillis() - initTime > 3000){
                Toast.makeText(this, "종료하려면 한번더 누르세요!!", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                initTime = System.currentTimeMillis()
                return true
            }
        }
        return super.onKeyDown(keyCode, event)
    }
}

        val binding = ActivityPhoneSizePraBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)
        if(Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R){
            val windowsMatrix: WindowMetrics = windowManager.currentWindowMetrics
            binding.textView.text = "width : ${windowsMatrix.bounds.width()}, height : ${windowsMatrix.bounds.height()}"
        } else {
            val display = windowManager.defaultDisplay
            val displayMetrics = DisplayMetrics()
            display?.getRealMetrics(displayMetrics)
            binding.textView.text = "width: ${displayMetrics.widthPixels}, height : ${displayMetrics.heightPixels}"
        }
    }
}

        val binding = ActivityVibratorPraBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)
        binding.BeepBtn.setOnClickListener {
            Log.d("fifo23", "beep ~")
            val uri = RingtoneManager.getDefaultUri(RingtoneManager.TYPE_NOTIFICATION)
            val ringtone = RingtoneManager.getRingtone(applicationContext, uri)
            ringtone.play()
        }
        binding.VibrateBtn.setOnClickListener {
            Log.d("fifo23", "vibrate ~")
            val vibrator = if(Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S){
                val manager = getSystemService(Context.VIBRATOR_MANAGER_SERVICE) as VibratorManager
                manager.defaultVibrator
            }else{
                getSystemService(VIBRATOR_SERVICE) as Vibrator
            }
            if(Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
                vibrator.vibrate(VibrationEffect.createOneShot(500, VibrationEffect.DEFAULT_AMPLITUDE))

            }
        }
    }
}

                manager.createNotificationChannel(channel)
                builder = NotificationCompat.Builder(this,channelId)
            }else{
                builder = NotificationCompat.Builder(this)
            }
            builder.setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_notification_overlay)
            builder.setWhen(System.currentTimeMillis())
            builder.setContentTitle("Title")
            builder.setContentText("TEXT")

            val KEY_TEXT_REPLY= "key_text_reply"

                setLabel(replyLabel)
                build()
            }
            val replyIntent = Intent(this, ReplyReciver::class.java)
            val replyPendingIntent = PendingIntent.getBroadcast(
                this, 30, replyIntent, PendingIntent.FLAG_MUTABLE)
                builder.addAction(
                    NotificationCompat.Action.Builder(
                        R.drawable.send,
                        "답장",
                        replyPendingIntent
                    ).addRemoteInput(remoteInput).build()
                )
            manager.notify(11,builder.build())
        }
    }

package com.example.chapter10.test2
import android.app.NotificationManager
import android.app.RemoteInput
import android.content.BroadcastReceiver
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.util.Log
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
class ReplyReciver : BroadcastReceiver() {
    //알림의 입력 글 희득
    override fun onReceive(context: Context, intent: Intent) {
        // This method is called when the BroadcastReceiver is receiving an Intent broadcast.
        val replyTxt = RemoteInput.getResultsFromIntent(intent)?.getCharSequence("key_text_reply")
        Log.d("fifo23", "replyTxt : $replyTxt ")
        //알람 취소
        val manager = context.getSystemService(
            AppCompatActivity.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager
        manager.cancel(11)
    }
}

            var remoteInput: RemoteInput = RemoteInput.Builder(KEY_TEXT_REPLY).run{
                setLabel(replyLabel)
                build()
            }
            val replyIntent = Intent(this, kakaoBroadCast::class.java)
            val replyPendingIntent = PendingIntent.getBroadcast(
                this, 30, replyIntent, PendingIntent.FLAG_MUTABLE
            )
            builder.addAction(
                NotificationCompat.Action.Builder(
                    R.drawable.send,
                    "답장",
                    replyPendingIntent
                ).addRemoteInput(remoteInput).build()

class MyDecoration(val context: Context): RecyclerView.ItemDecoration(){
    override fun onDraw(c: Canvas, parent: RecyclerView, state: RecyclerView.State) {
        super.onDraw(c, parent, state)
        c.drawBitmap(BitmapFactory.decodeResource(context.resources, R.drawable.stadium), 0f, 0f, null)
    }
    override fun getItemOffsets(
        outRect: Rect,
        view: View,
        parent: RecyclerView,
        state: RecyclerView.State
    ) {
        super.getItemOffsets(outRect, view, parent, state)
        val index = parent.getChildAdapterPosition(view)+1
        if(index %3 ==0)
            outRect.set(10,10,10,60)
        else
            outRect.set(10,10,10,0)
        view.setBackgroundColor(Color.LTGRAY)
        ViewCompat.setElevation(view, 20.0f)
    }

package com.example.chapter11_jectpack
import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory
import android.graphics.Canvas
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.Rect
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable
import android.os.Bundle
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import androidx.core.content.res.ResourcesCompat
import androidx.core.view.ViewCompat
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import com.example.chapter11_jectpack.databinding.FragmentOneBinding
import com.example.chapter11_jectpack.databinding.FragmentTwoBinding
import com.example.chapter11_jectpack.databinding.ItemRecyclerviewBinding
class MyViewHolder(val binding: ItemRecyclerviewBinding) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(binding.root)
class MyAdapter(val datas: MutableList<String>) : RecyclerView.Adapter<RecyclerView.ViewHolder>(){
    //항목 값이 리던 된다.
    override fun getItemCount(): Int {
        return datas.size
    }
    //이용하고자하는 홀더를 정해서 리턴
    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): RecyclerView.ViewHolder =
        MyViewHolder(ItemRecyclerviewBinding.inflate(LayoutInflater.from(parent.context),parent,
            false))
    //항목하나를 구성하기위한 함수 onCreateViewHolder 가 리턴되면서 0번 항목 1번 항목 .....
    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: RecyclerView.ViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val binding = (holder as MyViewHolder).binding
        binding.itemData.text = datas[position]
    }
}
class MyDecoration(val context: Context) : RecyclerView.ItemDecoration(){
    //배경 그릴때 호출 아이템들이 그려지기전에 한번만 그려진다.
    override fun onDraw(c: Canvas, parent: RecyclerView, state: RecyclerView.State) {
        super.onDraw(c, parent, state)
        val width = parent.width
        val height = parent.height
        val dr: Drawable? = ResourcesCompat.getDrawable(context.resources, R.drawable.kbo, null)
        val drWith = dr?.intrinsicWidth
        val drHeight = dr?.intrinsicHeight
        //이미지 사이즈
        val left = width/2 - drWith?.div(2) as Int
        val top = height/2 -drHeight?.div(2) as Int
        c.drawBitmap(BitmapFactory.decodeResource(context.resources, R.drawable.kbo),
            left.toFloat(), top.toFloat(), null)
    }
    //개별적인 항목에 대한 작업
    override fun getItemOffsets(
        outRect: Rect,
        view: View,
        parent: RecyclerView,
        state: RecyclerView.State
    ) {
        super.getItemOffsets(outRect, view, parent, state)
        val index = parent.getChildAdapterPosition(view)+1
        //3개씩 묵여있는 듯한 효과
        if(index % 3 == 0){
            outRect.set(10,10,10,60)
        }else{
            outRect.set(10,10,10,0)
        }
        //배경색
        view.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#28A0FF"))
        //엘리베이션 효과적용
        ViewCompat.setElevation(view, 20.0f)
    }
}
class OneFragment : Fragment() {
    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater, container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?
    ): View? {
        val binding = FragmentOneBinding.inflate(inflater,container,false)
        //서버나 네트워킹은 나중에 이건 가상의 데이터 리스트
        val datas = mutableListOf<String>()
        for(i in 1..100){
            datas.add("Item $i")
        }
        //
        val adapter = MyAdapter(datas)
        val layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(activity)
        binding.jetpackPraReclyerview.layoutManager = layoutManager
        binding.jetpackPraReclyerview.adapter = adapter
        binding.jetpackPraReclyerview.addItemDecoration(MyDecoration(activity as Context))
        return binding.root
    }
}

    class MyFragmentPagerAdapter(activity: FragmentActivity) : FragmentStateAdapter(activity){
        val fragments: List<Fragment>
        init {
            fragments = listOf(OneFragment(),TwoFragment(), ThreeFragment())
        }
        override fun getItemCount(): Int = fragments.size
        override fun createFragment(position: Int): Fragment = fragments[position]
    }

        toggle.syncState()
        val adapter = MyFragmentPagerAdapter(this)
        binding.viewpaper.adapter = adapter

class TablayoutPra : AppCompatActivity() {
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        val binding = ActivityTablayoutPraBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)
        supportFragmentManager.beginTransaction().add(R.id.tabContent, FragmentOne()).commit()
        binding.tabs.addOnTabSelectedListener(object : TabLayout.OnTabSelectedListener {
            override fun onTabReselected(tab: TabLayout.Tab?) {
            }
            override fun onTabSelected(tab: TabLayout.Tab?) {
                val transaction = supportFragmentManager.beginTransaction()
                when(tab?.text){
                    "Tab1" -> transaction.replace(R.id.tabContent, FragmentOne())
                    "Tab2" -> transaction.replace(R.id.tabContent, FragmentTwo())
                    "Tab3" -> transaction.replace(R.id.tabContent, FragmentThree())
                }
                transaction.commit()
            }
            override fun onTabUnselected(tab: TabLayout.Tab?) {
            }
        })
    }
}

package com.example.chapter12_meterial
import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.Rect
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import androidx.core.view.ViewCompat
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import com.example.chapter12_meterial.databinding.ItemRecylerviewBinding
//뷰홀더 클레스 정의 리사이클러뷰 사용할거기 떄문에 리사이클러뷰 홀더 사용 인자값으로 바인딩 아이템 데이타
class MyViewHolder(val binding: ItemRecylerviewBinding): RecyclerView.ViewHolder(binding.root)
//어뎁터 클레스 정의 데이타는 list 형식으로 문자열값
class MyAdapter(val datas: MutableList<String>) : RecyclerView.Adapter<RecyclerView.ViewHolder>() {
    override fun getItemCount(): Int {
        return datas.size
    }
    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): RecyclerView.ViewHolder
        = MyViewHolder(ItemRecylerviewBinding.inflate(LayoutInflater.from(parent.context), parent, false))
    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: RecyclerView.ViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val binding = (holder as MyViewHolder).binding
        binding.itemData.text=datas[position]
    }
}
//데코레이션 작업하기 위한 클레스 정의 컨텍스트를 받고 리사이클러뷰를 구성할대에서에 대한 데코레이션작업
class Mydecoration(val context: Context) : RecyclerView.ItemDecoration() {
    override fun getItemOffsets(
        outRect: Rect,
        view: View,
        parent: RecyclerView,
        state: RecyclerView.State
    ) {
        super.getItemOffsets(outRect, view, parent, state)
        val index = parent.getChildAdapterPosition(view) +1
        //3개씩 묶기
        if (index % 3 == 0 ) //left, top,right, bottom
            outRect.set(10,10,10,60)
        else
            outRect.set(10,10,10,10)
        //16진수로 배경색 컬러지정
        view.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#28a0ff"))
        //엘리베이션 효과 적용
        ViewCompat.setElevation(view, 20.0f)
    }
}

package com.example.chapter12_meterial
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import android.os.Bundle
import android.util.Log
import android.view.Menu
import android.view.MenuItem
import androidx.appcompat.app.ActionBarDrawerToggle
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
import androidx.fragment.app.FragmentActivity
import androidx.viewpager2.adapter.FragmentStateAdapter
import com.example.chapter12_meterial.databinding.ActivityMainBinding
import com.google.android.material.tabs.TabLayoutMediator
class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    //토글버튼 인스턴스화 될때 사용할라고 선언해놓고
    lateinit var toggle: ActionBarDrawerToggle
    //어뎁터 하나 만들어놓고
    class MyFragmentPagerAdapter(activity: FragmentActivity): FragmentStateAdapter(activity){
        var fragments: List<Fragment>
        init {
            fragments= listOf(meterialFragmentOne(), meterialFragmentTwo(), meterialFragmentThree())
        }
        override fun getItemCount(): Int = fragments.size
        override fun createFragment(position: Int): Fragment = fragments[position]
    }
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        val binding = ActivityMainBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)
        //no Action바 해놓고 메인xml 구성되있는 엑션바 장착
        setSupportActionBar(binding.meterialToolbar)
        //토글버튼 인스턴트화 엑션바에 토글버튼 그리고 인스턴스화 시킨다.
        toggle = ActionBarDrawerToggle(this, binding.meterialDrawer, R.string.meterial_drawer_opened,
        R.string.meterial_drawer_closed)
        supportActionBar?.setDisplayHomeAsUpEnabled(true)
        toggle.syncState()
        //어뎁터 생성
        val adapter = MyFragmentPagerAdapter(this)
        //페이저에 어뎁터 장착
        binding.meterialViewpager.adapter = adapter
        //텝과 페이저 연동
        TabLayoutMediator(binding.meterialTabs, binding.meterialViewpager){
            tab, position ->
            tab.text = "Tab${(position + 1)}"
        }.attach()
    }
    // 상당 옵션메뉴 구성 하기위해 호출되는 메소드 오버라이딩
    // menu 폴더의 main_menu 화면에 인플레이션
    override fun onCreateOptionsMenu(menu: Menu?): Boolean {
        menuInflater.inflate(R.menu.menu_main, menu)
        return super.onCreateOptionsMenu(menu)
    }
    // 상단 옵션메뉴 클릭했을때 호출되는 메소드 오버라이딩
    override fun onOptionsItemSelected(item: MenuItem): Boolean {
        //이벤트가 토글버튼에서 제공된거라면
        if(toggle.onOptionsItemSelected(item)){
            Log.d("fifo23", "토글버튼에서 아이템이 선택되었다.")
            return true
        }
        return super.onOptionsItemSelected(item)
    }
}

package com.example.chapter13.intentPra
import android.content.Intent
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import android.os.Bundle
import androidx.activity.result.ActivityResultLauncher
import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts
import com.example.chapter13.DetailActivity
import com.example.chapter13.databinding.ActivityIntentPraBinding
class IntentPra : AppCompatActivity() {
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        val binding = ActivityIntentPraBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)
        val requestLauncher : ActivityResultLauncher<Intent> = registerForActivityResult(
            ActivityResultContracts.StartActivityForResult()){
            val resultData = it.data?.getStringExtra("result")
            binding.resultView.text = "result: $resultData"
        }
        binding.button.setOnClickListener {
            val intent = Intent(this, DetailActivity::class.java)
            intent.putExtra("data1","Hello")
            intent.putExtra("data2", 10)
            requestLauncher.launch(intent)
        }
    }
}

package com.example.chapter13.ActivityLifeCycle
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.PersistableBundle
import com.example.chapter13.databinding.ActivityLifecyclePraBinding
class LifecyclePra : AppCompatActivity() {
    var count = 0
    lateinit var binding: ActivityLifecyclePraBinding
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        //xml 파인딩
        binding = ActivityLifecyclePraBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        //버튼 클릭하면 count 증가 텍스트뷰에 변경되는값 지정 출력
        binding.countButton.setOnClickListener {
            count ++
            binding.resultView.text = "${count}"
        }
        setContentView(binding.root)
    }
    //데이터 손실을 방지하기위해 데이터 저장
    override fun onSaveInstanceState(outState: Bundle) {
        super.onSaveInstanceState(outState)
        outState.putInt("count",count)
    }
    //데이터 출력
    override fun onRestoreInstanceState(savedInstanceState: Bundle) {
        super.onRestoreInstanceState(savedInstanceState)
        val data = savedInstanceState.getInt("count")
        binding.resultView.text = "$data"
    }
}

package com.example.chapter13.ActivityControl
import android.os.Build
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.WindowInsets
import android.view.WindowInsetsController
import android.view.WindowManager
import com.example.chapter13.R
import com.example.chapter13.databinding.ActivityControlPraBinding
class ActivityControlPra : AppCompatActivity() {
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        val binding = ActivityControlPraBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)
        //스플레시 엑티비티 도 참조하자 개복치 강사의 치한터치앱 만들어보기를 참조하자.
        //엑티비티 제어 30 이후에
        if(Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
            window.setDecorFitsSystemWindows(false)
            //네비게이션, 상태바 숨기고 전체화면 구성하기위해 컨트롤러 변수에 할당
            val controller = window.insetsController
            //컨트롤러가 null 이아니면 상태바와 네비게이션 숨기기
            //이전버전에서는 풀스크린 모드 적용하기위해 else {} Flag속성 지정
            if (controller != null) {
                controller.hide(
                    WindowInsets.Type.statusBars() or
                            WindowInsets.Type.navigationBars()
                )
                //투명하게나올거냐 반투명하게 나올거냐 정도
                controller.systemBarsBehavior =
                    WindowInsetsController.BEHAVIOR_SHOW_TRANSIENT_BARS_BY_SWIPE
            } else {
                //이전버전에서의 전체화면
                window.setFlags(
                    WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_FULLSCREEN,
                    WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_FULLSCREEN
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.chapter13.Corutine
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import android.os.Bundle
import com.example.chapter13.R
import com.example.chapter13.databinding.ActivityCorutinePraBinding
import kotlinx.coroutines.*
import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.Channel
import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.consumeEach
import kotlin.system.measureNanoTime
class CorutinePra : AppCompatActivity() {
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        //데이터 바인딩 준비
        val binding = ActivityCorutinePraBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)
        binding.button.setOnClickListener {
            val channel = Channel<Int>()
            //코루틴으로 비동기 처리 연산 코드 작성
            val scope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.Default + Job())
            scope.launch {
                var sum = 0L
                //5초내로 응답가능하게 해야하므로 나노 밀리 세컨드 사용하자
                var time = measureNanoTime {
                    for(i in 1..2_000_000_000){
                        sum += i
                    }
                }
                //코루틴에서 비동기처리로 연산을 하면서 계산되는 값을 메은쓰레드로 넘겨주자
                channel.send(sum.toInt())
            }
            //스코프 생성 하고 런치(구동) 해서 텍스트 뷰에 찍어주자
            val mainScope = GlobalScope.launch(Dispatchers.Main){
                channel.consumeEach{
                    binding.textView.text = "sum : $it"
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.chapter14.Battery
import android.content.BroadcastReceiver
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.IntentFilter
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import android.os.Bundle
import android.util.Log
import com.example.chapter14.databinding.ActivityBatteryPraBinding
class BatteryPra : AppCompatActivity() {
    lateinit var receiver: BroadcastReceiver
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        val binding = ActivityBatteryPraBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)
        //메니페스트 파일 정적으로 등록하지 않고 동적으로 등록해서 사용하자.
        receiver = object : BroadcastReceiver(){
            override fun onReceive(p0: Context?, p1: Intent?) {
                when(p1?.action){
                    //화면이 켜진상태라면, screen on 를 로그에 찍자..
                    //화면이 꺼진상태라면, screen off 를 로그에 찍자..
                    Intent.ACTION_SCREEN_ON -> Log.d("fifo23", "screen on,,")
                    Intent.ACTION_SCREEN_OFF -> Log.d("fifo23", "screen off,,")
                }
            }
        }
        //intent filter 등록 하기위해 필터 변수에 .....
        val filter = IntentFilter().apply {
            addAction(Intent.ACTION_SCREEN_ON)
            addAction(Intent.ACTION_SCREEN_OFF)
        }
        //리시버 등록
        registerReceiver(receiver, filter)
    }
    override fun onDestroy() {
        super.onDestroy()
        //리시버 해제
        unregisterReceiver(receiver)
    }
}

package com.example.chapter14_battery
import android.content.Intent

import android.graphics.BitmapFactory
import android.os.BatteryManager
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import android.os.Bundle
import com.example.chapter14_battery.databinding.ActivityMainBinding
class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        val binding = ActivityMainBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)
        //add...........
        //베터리 상황만 희득만 하기위해 null
        //베터리 상태가 플러그되었는지 언플러그 되었는지 플러그 되있다면 AC고속충전중인지 USB 충전중인지 확인하고 이미지를 전환하는 코드작성
        registerReceiver(null, IntentFilter(Intent.ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED))!!.apply {
            when(getIntExtra(BatteryManager.EXTRA_STATUS, -1)){
                BatteryManager.BATTERY_STATUS_CHARGING ->{
                    when(getIntExtra(BatteryManager.EXTRA_PLUGGED, -1)){
                        BatteryManager.BATTERY_PLUGGED_USB -> {
                            binding.chargingResultView.text = "USEB Plugged"
                            binding.chargingImageView.setImageBitmap(BitmapFactory.decodeResource(
                                resources, R.drawable.usb
                            ))
                        }
                        BatteryManager.BATTERY_PLUGGED_AC -> {
                            binding.chargingResultView.text = "AC Plugged"
                            binding.chargingImageView.setImageBitmap(BitmapFactory.decodeResource(
                                resources, R.drawable.ac
                            ))
                        }
                    }
                }
                else -> {
                    binding.chargingResultView.text = "Not Plugged"
                }
            }
            //베터리 퍼센트 계산하는 로직
            val level = getIntExtra(BatteryManager.EXTRA_LEVEL, -1)
            val scale = getIntExtra(BatteryManager.EXTRA_SCALE, -1)
            val batteryPct = level / scale.toFloat() * 100
            binding.percentResultView.text = "$batteryPct"
        }
        //버튼에 클릭리스너를 달고
        binding.button.setOnClickListener {
            val intent = Intent(this, MyReceiver::class.java)
            sendBroadcast(intent)
        }
    }
}

package com.example.chapter14_battery
import android.app.NotificationChannel
import android.app.NotificationManager
import android.content.BroadcastReceiver
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.media.AudioAttributes
import android.media.RingtoneManager
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Build
import android.util.Log
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat
class MyReceiver : BroadcastReceiver() {
    override fun onReceive(context: Context, intent: Intent) {
        // This method is called when the BroadcastReceiver is receiving an Intent broadcast.
        Log.d("fifo23", "MyReceiver......")
        val manager = context.getSystemService(AppCompatActivity.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager
        val builder: NotificationCompat.Builder
        if(Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O){
            //26버전 이상
            val channelId = "one-channel"
            val channelName = "MyChannel One"
            val channel = NotificationChannel(
                channelId,
                channelName,
                NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_DEFAULT
            ).apply {
                //채널 정보설정
                description = "My Channel One Description"
                setShowBadge(true)
                val uri: Uri = RingtoneManager.getDefaultUri(RingtoneManager.TYPE_NOTIFICATION)
                val audioAttributes = AudioAttributes.Builder()
                    .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SONIFICATION)
                    .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_ALARM)
                    .build()
                setSound(uri,audioAttributes)
                enableVibration(true)
            }
            //채널을 NotificationManage 에  등록
            manager.createNotificationChannel(channel)
            //채널을 이용하여 builder 생성
            builder = NotificationCompat.Builder(context, channelId)
        } else{
            //26 버전 이하
            builder = NotificationCompat.Builder(context)
        }
        builder.run {
            //알람의 기본 정보
            setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_notification_overlay)
            setWhen(System.currentTimeMillis())
            setContentTitle("홍길동")
            setContentText("안녕하세요")
        }
        manager.notify(11, builder.build())
    }
}

package com.example.chapter15.JabService
import android.app.job.JobInfo
import android.app.job.JobScheduler
import android.content.ComponentName
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Build
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.PersistableBundle
import com.example.chapter15.databinding.ActivityJabServicePraBinding
class JabServicePra : AppCompatActivity() {
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        val binding = ActivityJabServicePraBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)
        binding.jobServiceStartBtn.setOnClickListener {
            //시스템에 요청하기 위해 잡스케쥴라변수와 데이터를 넣을 extras 변수 생성
            val scheduler = getSystemService(JOB_SCHEDULER_SERVICE) as JobScheduler
            val extras = PersistableBundle()
            //번들에 데이타를 담는 작업
            extras.putString("extra_data", "hello fifo23")
            //빌더로 시스템의 조건을 JobInfo에 네트워크 가 끊겼을때의 상황을 담고 데이터를 잠고 빌더를 빌드하고
            // 시스템에 의뢰해서 잡스케쥴러에 등록실행
            val builder = JobInfo.Builder(1, ComponentName(this,JobService::class.java))
            builder.setRequiredNetworkType(JobInfo.NETWORK_TYPE_UNMETERED)
            builder.setExtras(extras)
            scheduler.schedule(builder.build())
        }
    }
}

class JobService : JobService() {
    override fun onCreate() {
        super.onCreate()
        Log.d("fifo23", "jobService.. onCreate")
    }
    override fun onStartJob(p0: JobParameters?): Boolean {
        val param = p0?.extras?.getString("extra_data")
        Log.d("fifo23", "jobService.. onCreate $param ...")
        //3초간 덧샘연산하는 쓰래드 생성
        Thread(Runnable {
            var sum = 0
            for(i in 1..3){
                sum += i
                SystemClock.sleep(1000)
            }
            Log.d("fifo23", "JobService ... onStartJob.. thread $sum..")
            //로그를 찍고 업무끝났다고 보고
            jobFinished(p0,false)
        }).start()
        return true
    }
    override fun onStopJob(p0: JobParameters?): Boolean {
        //쓰래드를 생성하고 쓰레드를 사용하고있으니까 완벽하게 업무가 끝나지 않았으니까 false를 리턴하자.
        Log.d("fifo23", "JoService onStopJob ..............")
        return false
    }
    override fun onDestroy() {
        super.onDestroy()
    }
}

package com.example.chapter16.AppConnector
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.database.Cursor
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import android.os.Bundle
import android.provider.ContactsContract
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.activity.result.ActivityResultLauncher
import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import com.example.chapter16.databinding.ActivityJusorokBinding
class Jusorok : AppCompatActivity() {
    lateinit var binding: ActivityJusorokBinding
    lateinit var permissionLauncher: ActivityResultLauncher<Array<String>>
    lateinit var intentlauncher: ActivityResultLauncher<Intent>
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityJusorokBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)
        //주소록에 사람을 등록되있을때 주소록 접근에 대한 권한부여를 위한 코드를작성하자
        //권한이 없다면 토스트 메시지를 띄어주자.
        permissionLauncher = registerForActivityResult(
            ActivityResultContracts.RequestMultiplePermissions()
        ){
            for(entry in it.entries){
                if(entry.key == "android.permission.READ_CONTACTS" && entry.value){
                    //주소록 목록..
                    val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_PICK, ContactsContract.CommonDataKinds.Phone.CONTENT_URI)
                    intentlauncher.launch(intent)
                }else{
                    Toast.makeText(this, "required permission..", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }
        }
        //쿼리를 하는 커서를 만들고 데이터를 뽑아내고 이름과 전화번호를 출력하는 코드
        intentlauncher = registerForActivityResult(
            ActivityResultContracts.StartActivityForResult()
        ){
            if(it.resultCode == RESULT_OK){
                val curssor = contentResolver.query(
                    it!!.data!!.data!!,
                    arrayOf(
                        ContactsContract.CommonDataKinds.Phone.DISPLAY_NAME,
                        ContactsContract.CommonDataKinds.Phone.NUMBER
                    ),
                    null, null, null
                )
                if(curssor!!.moveToNext()){
                    binding.UserInfoView.text = "name: ${curssor?.getString(0)}, phone: ${curssor?.getString(1)}"
                }
            }
        }
        //버튼을 클릭했을때 주소록 목록을 띄우고 해당 유저의 정보를 얻어올때 READ_CONTACTS 권한이 있다면 정보를 얻어오는 코드작성
        binding.personSelectBtn.setOnClickListener {
            if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(
                    this,
                    "android.permission.READ_CONTACTS"
                ) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED){
                permissionLauncher.launch(arrayOf("android.permission.READ_CONTACTS"))
            }else{
                //주소록 목록..
                val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_PICK, ContactsContract.CommonDataKinds.Phone.CONTENT_URI)
                intentlauncher.launch(intent)
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.chapter16_cameraapppra
import android.content.Intent
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory
import android.net.Uri
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.Environment
import android.provider.MediaStore
import android.util.Log
import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts
import androidx.core.content.FileProvider
import com.example.chapter16_cameraapppra.databinding.ActivityMainBinding
import java.io.File
import java.sql.Date
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.*
class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    lateinit var binding: ActivityMainBinding
    lateinit var filePath: String
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityMainBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)
        //gallery request launcher..................
        val requestLauncher = registerForActivityResult(
            ActivityResultContracts.StartActivityForResult())
        {
            try{
                val calRatio = calculateInSampleSize(
                    it.data!!.data!!,
                    resources.getDimensionPixelOffset(R.dimen.imgSize),
                    resources.getDimensionPixelOffset(R.dimen.imgSize)
                )
                val option = BitmapFactory.Options()
                option.inSampleSize = calRatio
                var inputStream = contentResolver.openInputStream(it.data!!.data!!)
                val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(inputStream,null, option)
                inputStream!!.close()
                inputStream = null
                bitmap?.let {
                    binding.userImageView.setImageBitmap(bitmap)
                } ?: {
                    Log.d("fifo23", "bitmap null")
                }
            }catch (e: Exception){
                e.printStackTrace()
            }
        }
        binding.galleryButton.setOnClickListener {
            val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_PICK,MediaStore.Images.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI)
            intent.type = "image/*"
            requestLauncher.launch(intent)
        }
        //camera request launcher.................
        val requestCemeraFileLauncher = registerForActivityResult(
            ActivityResultContracts.StartActivityForResult()){
                val calRatio = calculateInSampleSize(
                    Uri.fromFile(File(filePath)),
                    resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.imgSize),
                    resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.imgSize)
                )
                val option = BitmapFactory.Options()
                option.inSampleSize = calRatio
                val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeFile(filePath, option)
                bitmap?.let {
                    binding.userImageView.setImageBitmap(bitmap)
                }
            }
        binding.cameraButton.setOnClickListener {
            //camera app......................
            //파일 준비...............
            val timeStamep: String =
                SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss").format(Date())
            val storageDir: File? = getExternalFilesDir(Environment.DIRECTORY_PICTURES)
            val file = File.createTempFile(
                "JPEG_${timeStamep}_",
                ".jpg",
                storageDir
            )
            filePath = file.absolutePath
            val photoUri: Uri = FileProvider.getUriForFile(this,
                "com.example.chapter16_cameraapppra",
                file
            )
            val intent = Intent(MediaStore.ACTION_IMAGE_CAPTURE)
            intent.putExtra(MediaStore.EXTRA_OUTPUT, photoUri)
            requestCemeraFileLauncher.launch(intent)
        }
    }
    private fun calculateInSampleSize(fileUri: Uri, reqWidth: Int, reqHeight: Int): Int {
        val options = BitmapFactory.Options()
        options.inJustDecodeBounds = true
        try {
            var inputStream = contentResolver.openInputStream(fileUri)
            //inJustDecodeBounds 값을 true 로 설정한 상태에서 decodeXXX() 를 호출.
            //로딩 하고자 하는 이미지의 각종 정보가 options 에 설정 된다.
            BitmapFactory.decodeStream(inputStream, null, options)
            inputStream!!.close()
            inputStream = null
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }
        //비율 계산........................
        val (height: Int, width: Int) = options.run { outHeight to outWidth }
        var inSampleSize = 1
        //inSampleSize 비율 계산
        if (height > reqHeight || width > reqWidth) {
            val halfHeight: Int = height / 2
            val halfWidth: Int = width / 2
            while (halfHeight / inSampleSize >= reqHeight && halfWidth / inSampleSize >= reqWidth) {
                inSampleSize *= 2
            }
        }
        return inSampleSize
    }
}

package com.example.chapter18.phonInfo
import android.Manifest
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.os.Build
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import android.os.Bundle
import android.telephony.PhoneStateListener
import android.telephony.TelephonyCallback
import android.telephony.TelephonyManager
import android.util.Log
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts
import androidx.core.app.ActivityCompat
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import com.example.chapter18.databinding.ActivityPhoneInfoPraBinding
class PhoneInfoPra : AppCompatActivity() {
    lateinit var telephonyManager: TelephonyManager
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        val binding = ActivityPhoneInfoPraBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)
        telephonyManager = getSystemService(TELEPHONY_SERVICE) as TelephonyManager
        val permissionLauncher = registerForActivityResult(
            ActivityResultContracts.RequestMultiplePermissions()
        ) {
            if (it.all { permission -> permission.value == true }){
                callChanged()
                 phoneinfo()
            }else {
                Toast.makeText(this,"permission denied...", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
        if(ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, "android.permission.READ_PHONE_NUMBERS") == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED &&
            ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, "android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE") == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED){
            callChanged()
            phoneinfo()
        }else{
            permissionLauncher.launch(
                arrayOf(
                    "android.permission.READ_PHONE_NUMBERS",
                    "android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE"
                )
            )
        }
    }
    private fun callChanged(){
        if(Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S){
            telephonyManager.registerTelephonyCallback(
                mainExecutor,
                object : TelephonyCallback(), TelephonyCallback.CallStateListener{
                    override fun onCallStateChanged(p0: Int) {
                        when(p0){
                            TelephonyManager.CALL_STATE_IDLE ->{
                                Log.d("fifo23", "idle")
                            }
                            TelephonyManager.CALL_STATE_OFFHOOK ->{
                                Log.d("fifo23", "offhook...")
                            }
                            TelephonyManager.CALL_STATE_RINGING ->{
                                Log.d("fifo23", "ringring...")
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            )
        }else{
            val listener = object: PhoneStateListener(){
                override fun onCallStateChanged(state: Int, phoneNumber: String?) {
                    when(state){
                        TelephonyManager.CALL_STATE_IDLE ->{
                            Log.d("fifo23", "idle....")
                        }
                        TelephonyManager.CALL_STATE_OFFHOOK ->{
                            Log.d("fifo23", "offhook")
                        }
                        TelephonyManager.CALL_STATE_RINGING ->{
                            Log.d("fifo23", "ringing")
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            telephonyManager.listen(listener, PhoneStateListener.LISTEN_CALL_STATE)
        }
    }
    private fun phoneinfo(){
        val countryIso = telephonyManager.networkCountryIso
        val operatorName = telephonyManager.networkOperatorName
        val phoneNumber = if (ActivityCompat.checkSelfPermission(
                this,
                Manifest.permission.READ_SMS
            ) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED && ActivityCompat.checkSelfPermission(
                this,
                Manifest.permission.READ_PHONE_NUMBERS
            ) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED && ActivityCompat.checkSelfPermission(
                this,
                Manifest.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE
            ) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        ) {
            // TODO: Consider calling
            //    ActivityCompat#requestPermissions
            // here to request the missing permissions, and then overriding
            //   public void onRequestPermissionsResult(int requestCode, String[] permissions,
            //                                          int[] grantResults)
            // to handle the case where the user grants the permission. See the documentation
            // for ActivityCompat#requestPermissions for more details.
            return
        } else {
        }
        telephonyManager.line1Number
        Log.d("fifo23", "$countryIso, $operatorName, $phoneNumber")
    }
}

        /*
            메인엑티비티 혹은 retrofit httpok 코드장성할 메인엑티비티파일을 구성할 xml 파일을

            create시켜주자 ps 레트로핏 Call 객체를 사용하자.
            메니페스트 Application 속성값에 android:name=".network.MyApplication" 추가해주자.

                (서버로부터 받아오는 데이터가 복잡한 부분이있기떄문에 모델을 두개로 분리시켜 받아왔다.)
        */
        val networkService = (applicationContext as MyApplication).networkService
        val userListCall = networkService.dogetUserList("1")
        userListCall.enqueue(object: Callback<UserListModel>{
            override fun onFailure(call: Call<UserListModel>, t: Throwable) {
                Log.d("fifo23", "cancel....")

            override fun onResponse(call: Call<UserListModel>, response: Response<UserListModel>) {

package com.example.chapter18.network
import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory

import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup

import com.example.chapter18.databinding.ItemRetrofitBinding
import okhttp3.ResponseBody
import retrofit2.Call
import retrofit2.Callback
import retrofit2.Response
class MyViewHolder(val binding: ItemRetrofitBinding): RecyclerView.ViewHolder(binding.root)
class MyAdapter(val context: Context, val datas: List<UserModel>?): RecyclerView.Adapter<RecyclerView.ViewHolder>(){
    override fun getItemCount(): Int{
        return datas?.size ?: 0
    }
    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): RecyclerView.ViewHolder
            = MyViewHolder(ItemRetrofitBinding.inflate(LayoutInflater.from(parent.context), parent, false))
    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: RecyclerView.ViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val binding=(holder as MyViewHolder).binding
        val user = datas?.get(position)
        binding.id.text=user?.id
        binding.firstNameView.text=user?.firstName
        binding.lastNameView.text=user?.lastName
        user?.avatar?.let {
            val avatarImageCall = (context.applicationContext as MyApplication).networkService.getAvatarImage(it)
            avatarImageCall.enqueue(object : Callback<ResponseBody> {
                override fun onResponse(call: Call<ResponseBody>, response: Response<ResponseBody>) {
                    if (response.isSuccessful) {
                        if (response.body() != null) {
                            val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(response.body()!!.byteStream())
                            binding.avatarView.setImageBitmap(bitmap)
                        }
                    }
                }
                override fun onFailure(call: Call<ResponseBody>, t: Throwable) {
                    call.cancel()
                }
            })
        }
    }
}

package com.example.chapter19_goglemapapp
import android.Manifest
import android.content.Context
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.location.Location
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import android.os.Bundle
import android.util.Log
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import com.google.android.gms.common.ConnectionResult
import com.google.android.gms.common.api.GoogleApiClient
import com.google.android.gms.location.FusedLocationProviderClient
import com.google.android.gms.location.LocationServices
import com.google.android.gms.maps.CameraUpdateFactory
import com.google.android.gms.maps.GoogleMap
import com.google.android.gms.maps.OnMapReadyCallback
import com.google.android.gms.maps.SupportMapFragment
import com.google.android.gms.maps.model.BitmapDescriptorFactory
import com.google.android.gms.maps.model.CameraPosition
import com.google.android.gms.maps.model.LatLng
import com.google.android.gms.maps.model.MarkerOptions
import com.google.android.gms.tasks.OnSuccessListener
//인터페이스 세개
// 플레이서비스 위치서비스 이용 가능 할때 , 이용 불가능 할때, 지도이용 가능 할때
class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity(), GoogleApiClient.ConnectionCallbacks,
        GoogleApiClient.OnConnectionFailedListener, OnMapReadyCallback{
    //위치정보 프로바이더가 가능할때 얻기가 가능할때 사용할
    lateinit var providerClient: FusedLocationProviderClient
    //위치정보 얻기위한 판단
    lateinit var apiClient: GoogleApiClient
    //지도객체
    var googleMap: GoogleMap? = null
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_main)
        //registerForActivityResult 인텐트를 실행시킬수 있는 코드를 작성했다면 이번엔
        //권한 설정을 위한 코트로 작성
        val requestPermissionLaungher = registerForActivityResult(
            ActivityResultContracts.RequestMultiplePermissions()
        ){
            if(it.all { permission -> permission.value == true }){
                apiClient.connect()
            }else{
                Toast.makeText(this,"권한거부....",Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
        (supportFragmentManager.findFragmentById(R.id.mapView) as SupportMapFragment)!!.getMapAsync(this)
        //클라이언트 api객체를 초기화 어떤 API를 쓸지 위치값과
        providerClient = LocationServices.getFusedLocationProviderClient(this)
        apiClient = GoogleApiClient.Builder(this)
            .addApi(LocationServices.API)
            .addConnectionCallbacks(this)
            .addOnConnectionFailedListener(this)
            .build()
        //퍼미션부여되어있다면 컨넥트
        if(ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this,Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) !== PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED ||
                    ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) !== PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED ||
                        ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this,Manifest.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE) !== PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            requestPermissionLaungher.launch(
                arrayOf(
                    Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION,
                    Manifest.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE,
                    Manifest.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
                )
            )
        }else{
            apiClient.connect()
        }
    }
    //맵 좌표 위도 경도를 받아서 카메라 위치를 옮겨주고 마커로 표시해주는 함수구현
    private fun moveMap(latitude: Double, logitude: Double){
        val latlng = LatLng(latitude, logitude)
        val position: CameraPosition = CameraPosition.Builder()
            .target(latlng)
            .zoom(16f)
            .build()
        //카메라 위치를 카메라 업데이트 펙토리를 사용해서 옮기자.
        googleMap!!.moveCamera(CameraUpdateFactory.newCameraPosition(position))
        //마커 아이콘 설정과 위치값지정 타티틀 지정
        val markerOption = MarkerOptions()
        markerOption.icon(BitmapDescriptorFactory.defaultMarker(BitmapDescriptorFactory.HUE_AZURE))
        markerOption.position(latlng)
        markerOption.title("MyLocation")
        //마커를 추가하자.
        googleMap?.addMarker(markerOption)
    }
    //위치 정보가 넘어오면 이거가지고 작업을 해주면된다.
    override fun onConnected(p0: Bundle?) {
        if(ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION)
            === PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED){
            providerClient.lastLocation.addOnSuccessListener (
                    this@MainActivity,
                    object: OnSuccessListener<Location>{
                        override fun onSuccess(p0: Location?) {
                            p0?.let {
                                val latitude = p0.latitude
                                val logitude = p0.longitude
                                moveMap(latitude,logitude)
                            }
                        }
                    })
                apiClient.disconnect()
            }
    }
    //맴버변수가 가용됬을쌔 사용되는 함수
    override fun onMapReady(p0: GoogleMap?) {
        googleMap = p0
    }
    //현재 가용할 수 있는 사용자가 없을때 호출되는 함수
    override fun onConnectionFailed(p0: ConnectionResult) {
        Log.d("fifo23", "map user failed....")
    }
    //잘사용하고 있던 로케이션 프로바이더가 사용안하게 됬을때 구현하는 함수
    override fun onConnectionSuspended(p0: Int) {
    }
}
